products.name: Revolut Instant Access Savings
products.description: A savings account that earns variable interest on AUD balances. Interest accrues and is applied daily. Features and fees will vary based on paid plan tier (Standard, Plus, Premium, Metal, Ultra).

depositRates.additionalInfo: Standard Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Rates may change at any time.
Plus Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Premium Plan p.a. variable interest rate (balances up to $250,000). Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Premium Plan p.a. variable interest rate (balances from $250,001 up to $1,000,000). Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Metal Plan p.a. variable interest rate (balances up to $250,000). Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Metal Plan p.a. variable interest rate (balances from $250,001 up to $1,000,000). Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Ultra Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Ultra Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all your personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Boosted promotional rate for 3 months on balances up to $100,000, available to new Revolut AU retail customers subject to specific conditions. After 3 months, rate will revert to your default plan rate

tiers.name: High Yield Savings Promotional Rate (balances up to $100,000)

applicabilityConditions.additionalInfo: Available to new Revolut customers who create a Revolut Instant Access Savings account within 1 month of completing KYC verification, during the promotional sign-up window. The promotional rate applies for 3 months from savings account creation, after which the default plan rate applies.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Available to eligible customers only. Business customers should apply for a Revolut Business account.

eligibility.additionalValue: Must be an Australian resident with a valid Australian residential address
eligibility.additionalInfo: Australian residents including temporary visa holders are eligible. Non-residents are not eligible for an Australian Revolut account.

features.additionalInfo: Manage your everyday spending with powerful budgeting and analytics, transfer money abroad, spend easily in the local currency, and so much more.
Real-time transaction monitoring, instant card freeze via app and disposable virtual card numbers.

products.name: Revolut Kids & Teens Instant Access Savings
products.description: A savings sub-account linked to a parent's Revolut Personal Account intended for children aged 6 to 15, earning variable interest on AUD balances. Features and allowances vary based on the parent's subscription plan tier.

depositRates.additionalInfo: Parent's Standard Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all the parent's personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Parent's Plus Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all the parent's personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Parent's Premium Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all the parent's personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Parent's Metal Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all the parent's personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

Parent's Ultra Plan p.a. variable interest rate. Interest is earnt and paid daily. Lower interest rates apply based on the total balance across all the parent's personal savings accounts. Rates may change at any time.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Kids & Teens is intended for children aged 6 to 15. When the RKT user turns 16, they may migrate to a 16–17 account. At 18, they may move to a full Retail account. The RKT account is force-closed on the last day before their 19th birthday.
Available to children of eligible Revolut account holders only. The parent or guardian must hold a Revolut Personal Account

eligibility.additionalValue: Must be an Australian resident with a valid Australian residential address
eligibility.additionalInfo: Australian residents including temporary visa holders are eligible. Non-residents are not eligible for an Australian Revolut account
A parent or guardian must hold an active Revolut Personal Account to create a Kids & Teens sub-account. The Kids & Teens account is linked to and managed by the parent's account

constraints.additionalInfo: Maximum total balance for the RKT Savings sub-account is A$699.00
